# Code of conduct

Bohemian Wind adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), as the code of conduct for everyone who takes part in this project: in issues, pull requests, reviews and every other project space.

In short: be respectful and welcoming, take criticism of the work as criticism of the work, and assume good faith. Harassment, insults, personal or political attacks, and publishing anyone's private information without their explicit permission are not accepted. That includes a client's data or a site's location: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Reporting

To report behaviour that breaks this code, write privately to the maintainers: open the repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a vulnerability**, and begin the title with "Conduct". Only the maintainers see the report. Every report is reviewed and answered, and the reporter's identity is kept confidential.

The maintainers decide on the response by the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant 2.1: a correction, a warning, a temporary ban or a permanent ban, depending on what happened.
